steps.text: Sign in to ChatGPT in a web browser.
Open your profile menu and choose My plan or Settings.
Choose Cancel subscription and follow the prompts.
steps.note: Check the end date the service shows. Payments stop on the date you set.

steps.text: Check your email for a confirmation.
steps.note: If you subscribed in the iPhone app, cancel in your Apple subscriptions. See the Apple App Store guide.
